enable_dashboard.description: Enable or disable the Ceph Manager Dashboard plugin globally.

dashboard_host.description: IP address or hostname the dashboard HTTP(S) server binds to. Use `0.0.0.0` to bind to all interfaces.

dashboard_port.description: TCP port the dashboard HTTP(S) server listens on. Commonly 8443 (HTTPS) or 7000 (HTTP, not recommended).

ssl.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the dashboard. Strongly recommended in production.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file for HTTPS. Must be readable by `ceph-mgr`.

ssl_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file for HTTPS. Must be readable and secure (e.g., mode 0600).

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: `internal` (Ceph's built-in user database) or `tls-client` (client certificate-based auth).

api_prefix.description: URL prefix for the REST API endpoints. Useful when proxying behind another web server.

modules.description: List of Ceph Manager modules to load *in addition to* the dashboard plugin. Common modules: `dashboard`, `prometheus`, `rook`, `influx`, `restful`.

items.description: Name of a Ceph Manager module to enable.

dashboard_pool.description: Name of the pool used for storing dashboard state (e.g., custom dashboards, settings). Usually a small, replicated pool like `cephfs_data` or `dashboard_state`.
